diagnostic_evidence.quote: The penultimate inequality follows from the approximation property of the local $L^2$ projection $\widehat{P}$ on $\widehat{V}_{h,k}$

issues.failure_explanation: The step requires the L2 projection error to satisfy $\|v-\widehat{P}v\|_{H^{k+1}}\lesssim h^{k+1}\|v\|_{H^{k+1}}$, which is false because the highest derivatives of $v$ are not removed by projection onto degree-$k$ polynomials. The standard approximation property holds in $L^2$ and $H^1$, not in $H^{k+1}$. The desired conclusion is true but the given proof does not establish it.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Use the standard trace inequality $\|v\|_{L^2(\partial K)}\lesssim h^{-1/2}\|v\|_{L^2(K)}+h^{1/2}\|\nabla v\|_{L^2(K)}$ and the usual $L^2$ and $H^1$ approximation properties of the local $L^2$ projection.
issues.overall_effect: The proof of Lemma 3.1 is incomplete; the trace/jump estimate is not justified as written, affecting the approximation part of Theorem 3.1.
issues.title: Invalid H^{k+1} approximation in trace estimate for Lemma 3.1
issues.why_classification: A standard local trace/approximation correction preserves the lemma and the main result.

issues.failure_explanation: The term $L_4$ contains the exterior trace $(\tilde{I}-\Lambda\tilde{I})^-$ on interior faces. The DG norm of $e=\tilde{I}-\Lambda\tilde{I}$ controls only the jump $\llbracket e\rrbracket$, not the individual trace $e^-$. Thus the displayed bound does not follow from the definition of the DG norm. A separate trace inequality and the approximation property of $e$ are needed.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Bound $\|e^-\|_{L^2(\partial K)}$ by the trace inequality on the neighboring element and use the $L^2/H^1$ approximation estimates for $e=\tilde{I}-\Lambda\tilde{I}$.
issues.overall_effect: The proof of Lemma 3.2 is incomplete; the continuity estimate used in Theorem 3.1 is not established as written.
issues.title: Unjustified interior trace control in Lemma 3.2
issues.why_classification: A standard trace inequality fills the gap without changing the lemma's conclusion.

issues.failure_explanation: The difference $\tilde{I}(x)-\tilde{I}(\Phi_h^{-1}(x))$ is controlled by the Lipschitz constant of $\tilde{I}$ times $|x-\Phi_h^{-1}(x)|$, not by $\|\mathrm{id}-\Phi_h^{-1}\|_\infty |\tilde{I}(x)|$. The bound requires an $H^1$ or $W^{1,\infty}$ norm of $\tilde{I}$, not merely its $L^2$ norm. The subsequent DG estimate also omits the resulting $H^1$ term.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Replace the $L^2$ bound by $\|\tilde{I}-\tilde{I}\circ\Phi_h^{-1}\|_{L^2}\lesssim h^{k+1}\|\tilde{I}\|_{H^1}$ (or $W^{1,\infty}$) and propagate this norm through the DG estimate.
issues.overall_effect: The proof of Lemma 3.3 is invalid as written; the stated estimate with only $L^2$ norm is not established by the given argument.
issues.title: Invalid composition error bound in Lemma 3.3
issues.why_classification: A local mean-value/Lipschitz correction preserves the lemma and the main theorem already assumes $H^{k+1}$ regularity.

issues.failure_explanation: The set $\Gamma^0_h$ is a $(d-2)$-dimensional subset of the boundary (a curve in 3D, points in 2D). The volume of elements whose boundary intersects $\Gamma^0_h$ is $O(h^{d-1})$ (e.g., $O(h^2)$ in 2D and 3D), not $O(h^{k+1})$ for $k\ge 2$. The correct set for the $T_3$ integral is the set of elements intersecting $\Gamma_h^-/\Phi_h(\Gamma^-)$, whose volume is $O(h^{k+1})$ by Lemma 3.5. Also (3.8) is a DG error estimate and does not imply a volume bound.

failure_location.quote: let $D_c$ denote the set of boundary elements intersected by the characteristic boundary $\Gamma^0_h$, which means $D_c =\{K\in \mathcal{T}_h:\partial K\cap \Gamma^0\neq \emptyset\}$. By (\ref{eq3.8}), $D_c$ satisfies $Vol(D_c)\lesssim h^{k+1}$ according to (\ref{eq3.8}).

issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Redefine $D_c$ as the elements whose boundary intersects $\Gamma_h^- \Delta \Phi_h(\Gamma^-)$, use Lemma 3.5 to obtain $Vol(D_c)\lesssim h^{k+1}$, and proceed with the trace inequality.
issues.overall_effect: The proof of the $T_3$ bound and hence Theorem 3.1 is incomplete as written.
issues.title: Incorrect volume bound for boundary elements in Theorem 3.1 proof
issues.why_classification: A local redefinition and correct citation fix the proof without changing the theorem's statement or rate.
